candidateDeployment.method: Targeted staging and exact file installation with no repository overlay, dependency installation, third-party download or async sync start.

wcl.note: The synthetic public report URL intentionally had no retrievable report; selection and bounded failure behavior were verified without claiming log evidence.

runtimeEvidence.summary: All six deployed Python files and migration 0025 match the immutable 8507030 candidate hashes after final restoration.
Transactionally rolled-back dry run and final apply produced one release, exactly two manifests and memberships, one active pointer, three immutable triggers and SELECT-only wow_app access.

Real build, WCL and general guest requests selected Raider.IO only, Warcraft Logs only and no Tool respectively while preserving the public response schema and writing bounded owner-isolated Trace v2.
A real PostgreSQL snapshot degraded to verified cache within 30 seconds; expired, invalid and unavailable isolated probes failed closed with zero ToolResults and no fixed fallback.
Restored P1 code passed the same three paths with Trace v1/fixed_allowlist while additive 0025 state remained, then exact P2 hashes were restored and produced Registry-backed Trace v2.
No async sync or backfill was started; the same three unrelated failed units were present before and after candidate deployment and no new failed unit appeared.

corrections: The plan whitelist now registers the previously approved SQLite retirement design as a separate next task without expanding the Phase 2 implementation scope.
The PostgreSQL Chickenbro route characterization now resets Registry cache state and asserts complete fail-closed Trace v2 identity instead of the historical v1 schema.
confirmedBoundaries: The initial release and source bindings contain exactly source:raiderio:v1 and source:warcraftlogs:v1.
Manifests are data-only and adapter dispatch accepts only two repository-owned implementation references after preflight.
Personal templates and SimC remain context evidence and no frontend or public response contract changed.
Trace v1 fixed_allowlist constants remain only in the frozen historical validator; Registry-backed requests use dynamic Trace v2 validation.
Unavailable, invalid and expired Registry states fail closed without invoking the former fixed allowlist.

risks: The overall data-health response remains partial for unrelated data domains even though chickenbro_tool_registry is verified.
Three unrelated systemd units were already failed before deployment and remain outside this task; no new failed unit appeared.

The existing intent classifier did not classify the Chinese shorthand 奥法 smoke as community_build, while the canonical supported Protection Warrior wording did; Phase 2 intentionally preserves classifier behavior and records this as a future capability gap rather than expanding scope.
Phase 2 remains exactly two Tools and is not a publication surface for generated code.

cleanup.reason: After archived main and origin parity, the isolated task worktree and local task/archive branches were removed; GitHub had already deleted the published task branch after merge. The PostgreSQL backup, additive 0025 tables and active immutable release were retained.

PR CI and post-merge scoped verification passed; local and origin main parity was verified before task cleanup, and the live runtime remains immutably bound to verified candidate 8507030.
